verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own programmatic surfaces, an MCP server and a CLI, that can query transactions and pull reports and financial statements. Its double-entry journal entries post to a general ledger. However, no evidence shows a full general-ledger or trial-balance export specifically, a conventional REST API spec (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404), or open output formats. Missing for 10: an explicit general-ledger and trial-balance endpoint or report, a documented REST/OpenAPI API, documented open export formats (CSV/JSON), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
